name: pnge-geochem-pw
description: Produced-water geochemistry and treatment: PHREEQC brine speciation and mineral-scaling prediction, NIST thermodynamic properties, material/energy balance (Rachford-Rice flash), tNavigator-style reservoir-fluid tooling. Includes water-chem-qaqc, lab-method-planner, and pnge-pw-treatment agents plus /water-chem-compare command for side-by-side brine chemistry comparisons.
